title: Get Dev Board Play Running
summary: Follow-up fix for direct `bun nx run @elements/board:dev` failure under a debugger terminal. Aligned the Nx toolchain versions so `nx`, `@nx/js`, `@nx/workspace`, and `@nx/devkit` all resolve to 21.6.11, eliminating the mixed 21.4.1/21.6.11 state reported by `bun nx report`. Validated `bun nx report` is clean and `bun nx run @elements/board:dev --verbose` starts Vite; also validated with `NODE_OPTIONS=--inspect` to cover debugger-style process startup. Stopped only the extra reproduction server processes afterward.
